records.title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
records.reason: The paper proposes an RL training curriculum; its contribution changes training sample/order strategy and does not reduce inference resource use.

records.title: Finding the Evidence: Discovering Decision-Supporting Tokens for On-Policy Reasoning Distillation
records.reason: The paper studies evidence-token distillation as a training method; it does not evaluate inference speed, memory, serving throughput, or KV-cache reduction.

records.title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
records.reason: WorldLines/ObsMem studies agent memory and reports increased latency for the proposed memory path (5.13s versus 3.35s for the cited baseline); linked agent-memory relevance exists but evidence does not support a cost-saving method.

records.title: FragFuse: Bypassing Access Control of Large Language Model Agents via Memory-Based Query Fragmentation and Fusion
records.reason: FragFuse is an access-control/security attack on tool-using agents; attack execution cost is not an inference optimization contribution.

records.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
records.reason: EvoArena/EvoMem evaluates memory evolution and reports task-quality/token-consumption tradeoffs, but does not establish that its method reduces deployed inference cost; relevance is exploratory.
